title: Kissed Malty Dutch Yogurt Bake
description: A comforting Dutch dish featuring Greek yogurt and a malty flavor, baked to a crisp in a dolsot stone bowl. This kosher-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, malt powder, and honey until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the eggs to the yogurt mixture and whisk until combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour in the melted butter and stir until the batter is smooth.
Pour the batter into a dolsot stone bowl.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
